positioning.en: A Grixis Tablet control deck. This build leans more heavily on land destruction and pairs that plan with Fin Fang Foom.
positioning.zh: 格利极色组的石板控制，这个构组更偏向炸地思路，配合非凡龙。

positioning.en: Jeskai Lessons survived the Gran-Gran ban and won two events. This list uses Artist's Talent to restore some of the explosiveness lost with Gran-Gran.
positioning.zh: 石板课在禁了奶奶之后，还以洁斯凯形态存在，并可以席卷两场。该牌表使用艺术家才能弥补失去奶奶后的爆发力。

positioning.en: One of the post-ban Mono-Green Landfall winners, using Mole Man, Moloid Master and Bristly Bill, Spine Sower to fill the slots left by Badgermole Cub.
positioning.zh: 禁牌后的纯绿地落席卷版本之一，用鼹鼠人和比利填补威威獭留下的位置。

positioning.en: Another post-ban Mono-Green Landfall winner, using the two-mana ramp spell Shared Roots and Keen-Eyed Curator to fill the slots left by Badgermole Cub.
positioning.zh: 禁牌后的纯绿地落席卷版本之一，用两费 Ramp 同根共生和锐目鉴物客填补威威獭留下的位置。

positioning.en: Dimir Midrange returned to the top of the metagame after the bans.
positioning.zh: 禁牌后重新回到环境顶端

positioning.en: A Dimir Midrange build with a full set of The Sackville-Bagginses, paired with Infestation Sage.
positioning.zh: 满编The Sackville-Bagginses的蓝黑中速构筑，并加入了Infestation Sage进行配合。

positioning.en: A different Orzhov Lifegain build featuring a full set of Raise the Past; it won an event this week.
positioning.zh: 和之前构筑不同，是满编Raise the Past的版本。本周席卷一场。

positioning.en: Boros Dragons returned after the bans, now with Smaug the Magnificent.
positioning.zh: 禁牌后重新回到环境，同时加入了Smaug

positioning.en: Mono-Red Dragons, an archetype that had briefly appeared earlier in the format, returned with Smaug the Magnificent and posted several Top 8 finishes this week.
positioning.zh: 以前最开始曾经进入过环境的纯红龙也在Smaug加持之下出现，本周拿下多个八强。

positioning.en: A Five-Color Humans list featuring the new card Key to the Side-Door.
positioning.zh: 使用了新牌Key to the Side-Door

positioning.en: A former Helping Hand/Oculus shell returned this week with the HOB cards Most Decrepit Old Bird and The Eagles Are Coming!
positioning.zh: 曾经的救援掘大眼套牌，本周加入HOB的Most Decrepit Old Bird和The Eagles Are Coming!后也重新回到环境。

positioning.en: A Jeskai Tablet list featuring the new card Plunder the Trollshaws.
A Jeskai Momo list featuring the new card The Lord of the Eagles.
positioning.zh: 使用了新牌The Lord of the Eagles

positioning.en: Selesnya Landfall had a small presence this week, but this list used new components similar to the Mono-Green builds.
positioning.zh: 白绿本周偏少，不过也使用了和纯绿类似的新组件
